statements.proposition: This change introduces zero breaking changes to existing functionality.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: impact claim settled by the diff: with no new env vars set, the OpenRouter default mapping for sonnet changes from anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 to anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet and for opus from anthropic/claude-opus-4 to anthropic/claude-3-opus, so existing requests are routed to different (older) models; wrangler.toml also changes the custom-domain route from cc.yovy.app to cc.xiaohui.cool. Whether a model remap counts as 'breaking' is a reading of the word, hence judgment and MEDIUM.
evidence: gh api repos/luohy15/y-router/pulls/2/files: formatRequest.ts removes mapModel's hard-coded 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4' and 'anthropic/claude-opus-4'; new types.ts PROVIDER_CONFIGS.openrouter.modelMappings has sonnet: 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', opus: 'anthropic/claude-3-opus'
index.ts selectProvider defaults to provider 'openrouter' when OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL unset, so mapModel(model,'openrouter') uses the new mappings
wrangler.toml patch: route pattern 'cc.yovy.app' replaced by 'cc.xiaohui.cool'
